about: The real app's 530 settings (audit of trunk 074f7e2b, 2026-09-19): id, home, type, English label, fresh-install default. The checklist tests/settings-grown.test.mjs walks. Fresh-install defaults live in public/settings-defaults.json (production), which S3 checks.
